title: Chlorophyll Extraction and Spectral Analysis with Spectrometer Calibration
author: Victor vmr Rodriguez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8eahtae
materials: Let the sample beaker stand for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare mixture in pestle
steps.instruction: Combine sample, magnesium sulfate, and acetone in the pestle.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 0.25 g of the sample into a pestle.
Weigh 0.13 g of Magnesium sulfate heptahydrate (ACS Bio Basic Inc., Catalog #MB0329.SIZE.2.5Kg) into the same pestle.
Add 1.0 mL of Acetone (Merck MilliporeSigma, Catalog #34850) to the pestle.

steps.title: Grind to homogeneous paste
steps.instruction: Grind the entire mixture until the sample is consistent and the Magnesium sulfate heptahydrate is completely dissolved into the paste.

steps.title: Transfer paste and wash pestle
steps.instruction: Move the paste to a beaker and rinse the pestle.

substeps.instruction: Add the paste into a 40 mL beaker.
Wash the pestle with 1.0 mL of Acetone (Catalog #34850) and empty the wash into the beaker.

steps.title: Dilute and mix thoroughly
steps.instruction: Add additional acetone and remix the sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 13.0 mL of Acetone (Catalog #34850) to the 40 mL beaker.
Mix the sample thoroughly, pressing and remixing several times.

steps.title: Filter into test tube
steps.instruction: Filter the sample into a 20 mL test tube using a 20 µm retention filter paper.

steps.title: Allow sample to stand
steps.instruction: Let the filtrate stand for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Aliquot to PCR tubes
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of the standing sample to two PCR tubes and label them for duplicate analysis.

steps.title: Centrifuge to settle particulates
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the two PCR tubes at 1200 g for 1 minute.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: From each PCR tube, transfer 100 µL of the clear supernatant (top layer) to a new PCR tube.

steps.title: Measure absorbance
steps.instruction: Place each tube in the spectrometer and record absorbance at 647 nm and 664.5 nm; take log base 10 of the absorbance percentages and denote them as A647 and A664.

steps.title: Calculate chlorophyll concentrations
steps.instruction: Compute concentrations using: CHL A = 20.47·A647 – 4.73·A664; CHL B = 12.63·A664 – 2.52·A647; CHL Total = CHL A + CHL B. Then divide each concentration by 1000, multiply by the total acetone volume used, and divide by the sample mass (0.25 g) to obtain mg g⁻¹.

steps.title: Verify duplicate readings
steps.instruction: Confirm that the duplicate absorbance readings agree within an acceptable margin of error.

steps.title: Prepare base calibration tube
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of Acetone (Bio Basic Inc., Catalog #AC1200.SIZE.1L) to a PCR tube and label it “base.”

steps.title: Calibrate spectrometer
steps.instruction: Use the “base” PCR tube to calibrate the spectrometer.
